content:
Counterfeit and diverted skincare products are a real concern in India's online marketplace, especially for popular complexion-focused creams. Here's how to make sure you're getting a genuine product.

Why This Matters

Counterfeit skincare doesn't just waste money — it can contain incorrect or unsafe ingredient concentrations, since counterfeiters don't follow the same formulation or manufacturing standards as the original brand. This makes verifying authenticity a genuine safety consideration, not just a value one.

Where to Buy Safely

Official website. Buying directly from the brand's official website is generally the most reliable way to ensure authenticity, correct batch/formulation, and access to proper customer support if something goes wrong.

Authorized sellers only. If buying through a marketplace, check whether the seller is explicitly listed as an authorized retailer by the brand.

Signs You Might Be Looking at a Counterfeit

  • Price significantly lower than the official website with no clear explanation
  • Packaging inconsistencies — different fonts, colors, or missing batch/manufacturing information compared to official product photos
  • Seller has no verifiable business information or return policy
  • Product arrives with a different scent, texture, or packaging than described
  • No option to verify authenticity or contact the actual brand

What to Check Before Ordering

  1. Compare seller/marketplace listing photos closely against the official website's product images
  2. Check the seller's ratings and read recent reviews specifically mentioning authenticity
  3. Verify the seller is authorized, if buying anywhere other than the official website
  4. Check for a clear refund/return policy — legitimate sellers almost always offer one

How to Find Original Youth Face Cream: Quick Checklist

  • Product name: the jar and box should read Youth Face Beauty Cream.
  • Net quantity: a single jar is 25g; Pack of 2 is 2 × 25g and Pack of 3 is 3 × 25g.
  • Ingredients: kojic acid and alpha arbutin should be listed on the pack — see the Youth Face Cream ingredients page.
  • Seller details: a real business name, address and phone number. Our store is Beauty Mart, Azad Nagar, Bhatkal, Karnataka 581320, WhatsApp +91 99808 81230.
  • Claims: be careful with listings that promise "whitening", "permanent" or "overnight" results.
  • Price: compare with the current price on the Youth Face Cream price page; a much lower price is a warning sign.

Not sure about a listing? Send us a photo on WhatsApp at +91 99808 81230 and we will help you check it.

What to Do If You Suspect You Received a Fake

  • Contact the seller/marketplace directly with your concerns and request a refund
  • Reach out to the brand's official customer support to report the purchase
  • Avoid using a suspected counterfeit product on your skin, since ingredient concentrations may be inaccurate or unsafe

Frequently Asked Questions

Is it safe to buy skincare from marketplaces like Amazon or Flipkart? Generally yes, if purchasing from a seller explicitly marked as authorized/official — always check seller credentials before ordering.

How can I verify a seller is authorized? Check the brand's official website for a list of authorized retailers, or contact the brand's customer support directly to confirm.

What should I do if a product doesn't match what I expected? Contact the seller for a refund/return, and consider reporting the issue to the brand directly if you suspect counterfeiting.
